title: Austin Tackles Tax Assessment Errors
summary:
*   The Austin City Council's special meeting focused almost entirely on rectifying property tax valuations from the previous year (1921).
*   Numerous resolutions were approved to reduce individual property assessments, primarily for improvements, benefiting various residents and businesses.
*   These adjustments were made to correct errors by tax assessors or to formally record reductions previously agreed upon with the Board of Equalization that hadn't been updated on the tax rolls.
*   The Council mandated the Assessor and Collector to update official tax records to reflect these valuation changes and credit the reductions.
